text_block_list.text:
Give me a minute to put my luggage<n>in my room,
then we can begin<n>discussing—
Ah, Maruzen! Is your injury all<n>better?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yep! ♪ Back to being the bomb!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... You're not doing half bad<n>these days
yourself, Grass.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Why, thank you for the compliment.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I have my sights set on a goal, so I<n>must keep
working hard until I reach<n>it.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yep. I love that fire in your eyes. ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: See you on the flip side!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Maruzen... She looms as large as<n>ever.
choice_data_list: But you won't be overshadowed anymore!
But you won't be overshadowed anymore!

text_block_list.text:
With that, Grass kicks off the summer<n>camp
stronger than she was last<n>year!
